description:
A pointer to an approved upstream artifact — never its full content
(hard rule 3). Mirrors the existing approved_artifact_content/
approved_artifact_summaries split in
app/services/ai_generation.py's build_prioritized_context: `summary`
here plays the same role as agent_context_summary there (a bounded,
pre-computed stand-in for the full document), and is the ONLY textual
content this reference may carry — there is deliberately no
`full_content` field on this model.

artifact_version_id.description: None means 'the artifact's current version' — resolved at execution time, not pinned.
artifact_version_id.title: Artifact Version Id

status.description: The artifact's status at reference time, e.g. 'APPROVED' — for audit/display only, not re-validated by this contract.
status.title: Status

summary.description: A bounded context summary (see app/services/artifact_summary.py) — never the full document body.
summary.title: Summary

title: ArtifactReference
